intro: Jack in the Box is the 24-hour burger chain famous for mixing it all: Jumbo Jack burgers, the cult-favorite two-for-99-cent tacos, curly fries, breakfast served any time and over-the-top Munchie Meals. It is the go-to late-night run. Below is the full Jack in the Box menu with prices and calories for 2026, organized by category.
quick_answer: Jack in the Box is a late-night staple. The Jumbo Jack burger is about $3.69, two famous tacos are just $0.99, and the Ultimate Cheeseburger is around $6.99. Combos with curly fries and a drink start at $7.99, and the Jack's value menu has items under $4.
hot_deal: Jack in the Box value: the famous 2 Tacos are still just $0.99, and Jack's value menu keeps burgers, grilled cheese and Tiny Tacos under $4. Combos with curly fries and a drink start around $7.99, and Munchie Meals bundle a big late-night feast from about $10. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Jumbo Jack at Jack in the Box?
faqs.a: The Jumbo Jack is about $3.69, or $4.19 with cheese. As a combo with curly fries and a drink it is around $7.99. The Jumbo Jack is about 490 calories.

faqs.q: How much are Jack in the Box tacos?
faqs.a: The famous Jack in the Box tacos are 2 for $0.99, one of the best deals in fast food. The two-taco order is about 340 calories.

faqs.q: Does Jack in the Box serve breakfast all day?
faqs.a: Yes. Most Jack in the Box locations are open 24 hours and serve breakfast any time, including the Breakfast Jack, Supreme Croissant and Loaded Breakfast Sandwich.
The Munchie Meal is Jack's late-night combo: an entree plus tacos, curly fries and a drink, starting around $10. It is built for a big, cheap late-night feast.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Jack in the Box?
faqs.a: The best known are the Jumbo Jack, the two-for-99-cent tacos, curly fries, the Ultimate Cheeseburger, and the OREO shake.
